method.quality: SAP_QUALITY == 0; finite positive PDCSAP and finite time; no flux clipping
method.detrender: per quarter and gaps >0.5 d, linear Savitzky-Golay degree 2, odd window nearest 2.0 d, minimum 5, mode interp; median normalization; no adaptive clipping
method.template: negative box at primary frozen duration (Amendment 1: Montalto hours = 24 x CTOI value; other rows unchanged), integrated over 0.02043365 d LC exposure. Filter template with same linear detrender. No shape/duration fitting.
method.pdcsap_dilution: PDC already corrects crowding. Normalize and multiply PDC residuals by frozen reference CROWDSAP. Thus expected aperture-equivalent depth D*(1+TIC_contratio)*C_ref; no double crowd correction.
method.search: Period grid +/-3 period sigma, step <=max(T14,LC)*P/(4*1460), odd grid <=4097. For each period, phase bins step <=max(T14,LC)/4. Allowed phase distance <=3*sqrt(epoch_sigma^2+(cycles*period_sigma)^2)+LC from back-propagated nominal epoch at Kepler midpoint; unknown epoch or uncertainty => full phase. No period => all cadence centers plus half-cadence centers.
method.missing: Missing depth/duration => OPEN, no surrogate template or injections. Unknown epoch/period uncertainty => search diagnostic, cannot refute. Amendment 1 corrects Montalto duration units before flux; literal hours descriptive only and never determine verdicts.
method.noise: Robust per-quarter point noise from MAD of adjacent differences/sqrt(2), inflated by max(1,MAD of duration-smoothed residuals / white expectation). Independent quarter contributions with inverse variance weighting. Noise floors 1 ppm in aperture-equivalent units.
method.coverage: PROTOCOL.md: nominal and minimum period-grid coverage for refutation; saved best-grid coverage also reported. Single 100000 uniform P midpoint grid on [1,1460] days.
method.injections: 100 per target; deterministic RNG seed+KIC; raw PDCSAP before own detrender, multiplicative exposure-integrated template at frozen depth. Periodic inject on random phase and period drawn frozen +/-3sigma interval, run same period/phase search translated to injected ephemeris. Single uniform epochs over fixed Kepler span, including gaps. Success requires z>=7.1, depth consistency and epoch within max(T14,LC); periodic period within grid resolution and predicted Kepler midpoint phase within max(T14,LC). All trials denominator 100.
method.controls: 50 per CTOI same spring module, closest Kp, ties KIC; no KOI/TCE/TOI/CTOI by full public TIC crossmatch; >1000d catalog span. For single additionally fetch TIC Tmag and select 50 same-module nearest in Tmag before freeze. Module metadata checked from FITS primary HEADER ONLY before any flux.
method.depth_consistency: abs(depth_fit-depth_expected)<=3*sqrt(depth_fit_sigma^2+(CTOI_depth_error*ratio)^2); missing depth error=>0. Duration errors frozen but not fitted.
method.control_percentile: numpy percentile 99, linear interpolation; target z strictly exceeds. Also control passing count /50 and empirical rank (1+#controls>=target)/51.
method.verdict_order: Recovered gates first. Refuted if no z>=7.1 depth-consistent event, coverage>=0.9, SNR_expected>=15, injection recall>=0.9 and all required metadata/power inputs valid. Otherwise OPEN. Special single requires >=1 matching event for lead, else coverage>=0.9 AND recall>=0.9 for demotion; expected SNR recorded.
method.limits: 16 vCPU pod only, nice10; <=4 worker processes, BLAS threads1. No Mini flux processing. Pull by19UTC, finish about5h after resume.
method.search_shortlist: 16 strongest histogram proposals plus 16 strongest depth-compatible proposals, followed by actual-time filtered-template fits; nominal ephemeris always included.
